edits.new:
The legacy Quartz job and its nightly copy are retired: the schedule is a Temporal Schedule in this service (DP-10) and the ingest is continuous rather than a 01:00 batch (GAP-1226; ASM-2190).

The append-only verification job runs at 01:00 daily, one hour before the 02:00 chain check. The WORM path for the daily seal is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1233) and is agreed per environment with the storage owner.
